Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get Flagship Labs set up in your system. Attached are our completed onboarding items: Flagship_W9.pdf and a voided check (Flagship_voided_check.jpg).

Quick details to help your team create the vendor record and PO mapping:
- Legal name: Flagship Labs LLC
- DBA: Flagship AI
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Remit preference: ACH for recurring payments, wire for expedited payments
- Remit reference recommendation: use "Invoice #" or "PO #" followed by supplier name

If you need a signed bank authorization form we can complete DocuSign — I can send the link. Also including accounts-payable@flagshiplabs.com on this thread.

Next steps from our side if helpful: we can provide an invoice sample and a PDF of the standard payment terms (NET30).

Thanks,
Leah Torres
Head of Finance, Flagship Labs LLC
leah@flagshiplabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Leah — thanks for sending these over, appreciated.

A few items we need to complete setup on our side before issuing a PO:
1) Can you confirm the account number and routing for ACH and provide the SWIFT/BIC for wires (if you accept USD wires)? If you prefer, send the bank authorization via DocuSign and we will accept that as verification.
2) Please confirm the exact remit reference you want on our payments (examples: "Invoice 2026-12345 / Flagship Labs" or "PO 2026-4789 / Flagship AI").
3) Please attach a sample invoice showing the line-level PO references you expect us to consume.

Internal note: I am looping in Marissa (supplier ops) to coordinate PO creation and Monica (finance) to handle the micro-deposit verification for ACH activation.

Once we have the bank details and invoice sample I will create the PO and route through purchasing for approval. Expected ETA for PO creation after receipt of bank auth: 1-2 business days.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
